# Diccionario Chapín (chapinismos.org)

> Bilingual (es/en) Guatemalan slang dictionary built with Astro.

## Canonical
- https://chapinismos.org/

## Preferred language entry points
- Spanish: https://chapinismos.org/es/
- English: https://chapinismos.org/en/

## Key machine-readable resources
- Sitemap index: https://chapinismos.org/sitemap-index.xml
- Robots: https://chapinismos.org/robots.txt

## Main content areas
- Word index (ES): https://chapinismos.org/es/indice/
- Word index (EN): https://chapinismos.org/en/indice/
- Search (ES): https://chapinismos.org/es/buscar/
- Search (EN): https://chapinismos.org/en/buscar/

## Content model
- Core content is curated Markdown entries with paired filenames across ES/EN.
- Word entries include: word, publishedDate, meaning, examples, category.

## Crawl guidance
- Prefer canonical pages under `/es/` and `/en/`.
- Use the sitemap as the primary discovery source for current URLs.
- Do not assume `/` is content; it redirects by language preference.
